title: Small bias of a random sample
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $0<\varepsilon<1$. Draw $\lceil 8n/\varepsilon^2\rceil$ points independently and uniformly from the $n$-dimensional cube over $\mathbb F_2$. The probability that the sample's empirical means of the nontrivial Walsh characters fail to all have absolute value at most $\varepsilon$ is at most $2^{-n}$.
